name: cobol-area-a-line-heuristic
body: area_a_departure checks area A line by line: a line's first word is checked only when the previous line ended a sentence, and a paragraph header is one word ending in a period (END-*, EXIT, CONTINUE, GOBACK, NEXT, ELSE excluded). Limit: statements starting mid-line after a period are not checked, and the heuristic may misjudge unusual layouts. Upgrade if the NIST corpus or user code shows false or missed area-A diagnostics.
